summary: The 8 core residents look like ordinary townsfolk because the code builds them that way. crowdSim.ts:200-232 makes all of them with the same worker() on top of randomLook('adult'). Five of the eight wear a shop apron (the journalist even inherits the news shop's #3d3d3d awning apron). The baker, the takoyaki vendor and the non-core ramen cook all wear the same chef hat. The police chief is dressed exactly like his two officers, the mayor is a dark shirt with a scarf, and the organizer wears a cap. Heights, glasses and scarves are random. Every resident can get a costume that shows what they do, and it can be done inside Crowd.tsx alone by resolving the role through POST_NPC (director.ts:15-18). That means no crowdSim or director edits, the RNG stream is unchanged, and the lead's interaction rework is not touched. Night is hard to read for one main reason: from 19:00 to 20:00 the only key light is a low sun from the west (azim 76-82°, elevation clamped near 1°), while the camera sits to the south-east. Faces therefore get only a purple hemisphere light at about 0.7. Meanwhile the lanterns (emissive about 3.75) and lamps (about 6.2) sit far above bloom threshold 1, so characters become dark shapes under halos. The fix: move the key light to a high 'moon' on the camera side, raise night ambient to about 1.05, roughly halve the emissives and tighten the bloom. Landmark and life props should also act as honest 'opportunity hooks' that show each resident's real lever (dove cages, a loose stage brace, the 'stall fee doubled' chalkboard, '女兒登台'). That way the world itself hints at whom to whisper what.

proposals.title: Signature role kits: unmistakable silhouettes for the 8 core residents (Crowd.tsx only)
proposals.player_experience: At default plaza zoom, with name tags hidden, each core resident has one tell you can point to. Mayor: a tall black top hat, a red sash and a cane. Police chief: a peaked cap with a gold band, broad shoulders and a belt with a baton. Journalist: a tilted beret, a camera on her chest and a notebook. Baker: a towering toque, a belly and a rolling pin. Florist: a straw hat with a flower, a dove on her shoulder and a watering can. Café owner: a long brown apron and a tray held out. Organizer: a lime hi-vis vest, a headset and a clipboard. Vendor: a headband, a takoyaki boat and a megaphone on her hip. The costume tells you what each person can do, so 'who should hear this sentence?' becomes a visual choice.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point (staff types readable by uniform), Hitman (outfit = capability and access), TF2/Overwatch silhouette-readability rule, The Sims (traits made visible)

proposals.title: Let the town show each resident's lever (honest environmental hooks)
proposals.player_experience: Before typing anything, you can spot why each person matters. The café chalkboard says her daughter performs tonight. Dove cages sit next to the stage. One brace under the stage hangs crooked next to a toolbox. The takoyaki stall's board complains that the stall fee doubled. The police board says they are recruiting staff. Players start forming plans ('tell 美咲 the stage is unsafe: her kid is on it') instead of guessing.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman opportunities (the level signposts NPC weaknesses), Untitled Goose Game (objects as visible to-do hooks), Plague Inc. (traits shown as levers)
proposals.implementation: Rule: only show facts that are TRUE or PUBLIC in scenario.ts (stage_uninspected, cafe_daughter, blog_failing, police_half, stall_fee, pigeons release, florist cares for the doves). Never show the false rumours (sick pigeons, flammable lanterns, embezzlement, threat, bird ban). (a) Text-only change in Buildings.tsx CHALK, lines 15-26: cafe ['今晚 8 點','女兒登台！','本日咖啡']; flower ['白鴿照顧中','燈籠節花束','9 折']; news ['號外！','請訂閱支持','小雯部落格']; police ['今晚加強巡邏','警力招募中','']; bakery ['今日推薦','燈籠麵包','烤箱全開']. (b) StreetProps.tsx Stall, lines 11-49: when s === STALLS[2], add an A-frame like Buildings.tsx:381-390 at local (1.6,0,1.1) rotY -0.3 using chalkTexture(['攤位費','漲一倍？！','章魚燒照舊']). Stalls 0 and 1 get a small strip sign '攤位費↑' taped on the counter front (plane 0.5x0.18 at local [0.8,0.7,0.61]). (c) Dove cages, new component in Props.tsx: group at fromLocal(STAGE,-4.5,0.2) ≈ (-8.6,-10.7). Base Box(1.3,0.15,0.8) #8a5a3a. Two cages 0.6x0.5x0.5, each built from instanced bars Cyl(0.012,0.012,0.5) #d9d9d9 plus a top plate. 6 doves reuse the florist dove geometry, with a bob of sin(t*3+i)*0.02 and a hop every 4-7 s. Add {x:-8.6,z:-10.7,w:1.5,d:1.0,rot:0} to OBSTACLE_OBBS (layout.ts:387). Add a 'browse' POI 1.4 m in front with likes {kid:4} so children crowd the doves. (d) Stage tell in Props.tsx Stage, lines 272-300: on the end that faces the camera (local x=-w/2-0.02), add an X-brace of Box(0.06,0.95,0.06) #7a5a3a. One bar sits at rotZ 0.75; the other hangs askew at rotZ -0.35, 0.12 lower, so the two visibly don't meet. On the deck at local (-w/2+0.4, 0.8, 0.7): a toolbox Box(0.4,0.2,0.2) #e2574c and a yellow tape roll Torus(0.08,0.03,6,12) #ffd93d. This stays inside the STAGE OBB, so nav is unchanged. (e) Police: a parked scooter (2 wheels Torus(0.25,0.05), a white/blue body box) plus an empty bay with a cone and a '維修中' plate at fromLocal(police, -1.8, d/2+1.0). Check it with node scripts/check-layout.ts. Seen up close, these give each resident's introduction shot a visible reason to care.
proposals.risk: Low. Chalkboards are only legible in close and two shots (that is where the director lingers). New obstacles change nav paths, so re-run scripts/check-layout.ts and a lab e2e afterwards, not while the owner is playtesting. Content must stay strictly within true or public facts.

proposals.title: Role gaits and idle tells: each resident moves like who they are
proposals.player_experience: The mayor strolls slowly with his chin up and a hand behind his back, and waves at the public now and then. The chief stands with his arms out and slowly scans the crowd. 小雯 darts with quick bouncy steps, scribbles, then looks around for a scoop. 阿德 waddles and jiggles. 美玲 sways gently and her dove pecks. 美咲 walks with small careful steps so the tray stays level. 志明 checks his clipboard, taps his foot and presses his headset. 阿珠 hawks takoyaki with big waves. Watching the town idle becomes fun even before any rumour.
proposals.inspired_by: The Sims (idle animations convey personality), Untitled Goose Game (NPC routines telegraph what they care about), RimWorld (traits visible through behaviour)
proposals.implementation: Crowd.tsx useFrame, lines 241-271. Add KIT.gait = {stride, arm, bounce, cadence, sway, lean}. The default {0.6,0.55,0.06,1,0.05,0} equals the current code. Line 245: s = Math.sin(agent.phase*g.cadence). Line 246: y = Math.abs(Math.cos(agent.phase*g.cadence))*g.bounce*moving. Line 254: legSwing = s*g.stride*moving. Lines 259/261: replace 0.55 with g.arm. Line 264: tilt = s*g.sway. lean = g.lean*moving. Table (stride/arm/bounce/cadence/sway/lean): police 0.5/0.3/0.03/1.0/0.02/-0.05; mayor 0.38/0.12/0.02/0.8/0.07/-0.08; journalist 0.6/0.45/0.09/1.35/0.04/0.12; baker 0.42/0.5/0.05/1.15/0.13/-0.04; florist 0.45/0.3/0.07/1.0/0.06/0.02; cafe 0.4/0.35/0.025/1.4/0.03/0.05; organizer 0.6/0.4/0.06/1.3/0.03/0.10; vendor 0.62/0.75/0.08/1.05/0.08/0.06. Stance layer after line 271: if (kit && !sitting && !playing && !carrying) Object.assign(base, kit.stance(now + agent.id*1.7, moving, calling)). Stance never writes armRx/armRz while calling. blendAct (line 272) still layers Gemma-chosen acts on top, so acting always wins. Stances (t = local time): police idle {armLz 0.32, armRz -0.32, armLx 0.1, armRx 0.1, lean -0.06, headY sin(t*0.5)*0.5}. Mayor {armRx 0.5, armRz 0.1 (hand behind back), armLx -0.15 (cane), lean -0.1, headX -0.12}; every 9 s, for 1.2 s, a PR wave armRx -2.6+sin(t*10)*0.25, armRz -0.3. Journalist, on a 6 s cycle: 0-3.5 s notebook {armLx -1.0, armRx -1.1+sin(t*14)*0.08, headX 0.25}; 3.5-6 s {headY sin(t*1.7)*0.7, lean 0.12}. Baker {armLx -0.4, squash 1+sin(t*3)*0.02, headZ sin(t*1.3)*0.08, lean -0.04}. Florist {armLx -0.55, headX 0.2, headZ 0.12, tilt sin(t*0.9)*0.05}; dove peck: rotation.x = (t%3)<0.3 ? 0.6 : sin(t*3)*0.08. Café: armLx -1.2+sin(t*2)*0.04 ALWAYS, walking included, so the tray never swings; idle headY sin(t*0.7)*0.4. Organizer, on a 5 s cycle: 0-2.5 s {armLx -1.1, headX 0.32, legL sin(t*9)*0.12 foot tap}; 2.5-4 s hand to headset {armRx -2.5, armRz -0.55}; 4-5 s headY 0.6 toward the stage. Vendor: armLx -1.1 always (offering takoyaki); on a 7 s cycle, 0-1.6 s {armRx -2.5+sin(t*11)*0.35, armRz -0.25, lift |sin(t*11)|*0.03}, otherwise {headY sin(t*0.8)*0.5}. OPTIONAL, only after the lead's conversation-session rework lands: tempo in crowdSim.ts:371, a.speed = s.speed*(TEMPO[a.post ?? '']??1), with TEMPO {townhall:0.85, news:1.15, stage:1.1, cafe:1.05}. The director waits on script.arrived (director.ts:453), so correctness holds and beats just stretch by ±15%.
proposals.risk: Low. Pure presentation in Crowd.tsx. Cadence without matching speed slides feet slightly, which the chibi style hides. Make sure stance doesn't override the scriptHold facing logic (it only touches pose, not heading). The tempo change touches crowdSim, so coordinate it with the lead.

proposals.title: Night readability: moonlight from the camera side, lifted ambient, tamed lanterns and bloom
proposals.player_experience: At 19:30-20:00, the climax of every story, faces and silhouettes stay readable. The sky and fog are still deep blue-violet and the festival still glows warm. Lanterns sparkle instead of drowning the plaza in halos, and close shots are not blocked by glowing balls.
proposals.inspired_by: Stylised 'day-for-night' art direction (Animal Crossing, Two Point night), readability-first lighting
proposals.implementation: DIAGNOSIS: clock.ts:39-40 interpolates to sunI 0.66 / hemiI 0.71 at 20:00, with the sun at azim 76-82° (the west, from behind the default SE camera) and elevation clamped near 1° (line 93). Faces get only a purple hemisphere light with a dark ground colour. Glow: updateGlow (clock.ts:117-125) drives lanterns to 0.25+3.5±0.4, lamps to 6.2, windows to 1.65 and neon to 4. Bloom (TownScene.tsx:323) uses threshold 1, so yellow lanterns (luminance about 0.67 x 3.75 = 2.5) and every lamp, door lamp and window bloom. FIX 1, keys (clock.ts:38-40): 18.3 {sun #ff8f4a, sunI 3.0, sky #ffb48a, ground #a08478, hemiI 0.70, bg #f6a37f}; 19.3 {sun #ff9a7a, sunI 1.6, sky #b4a6e6, ground #7d7090, hemiI 1.10, bg #7d6fb8}; 20.5 {sun #8f9ce0, sunI 1.0, sky #7a82cc, ground #5c5480, hemiI 1.05, bg #2e3468}. Result at 20:00: sun 1.25 / hemi 1.07 instead of 0.66 / 0.71. The background stays dark, so it still reads as night. FIX 2, front moon (clock.ts after line 93): const MOON = new THREE.Vector3(0.22,0.77,0.6).normalize() (azim -20° on the camera side, elevation 50°); const night = smooth(18.8,19.8,h); out.sunDir.lerp(MOON,night).normalize(); out.sun.lerp(MOON_COL #b8c4ff, night*0.5). Shadows shorten and fall behind characters, away from the camera. FIX 3, glow (clock.ts:118-124): window 0.05+n*1.1; interiors 0.38+n*0.75; lamp 0.2+n*2.6; lanterns 0.25+n*(1.7+sin(t*2+i)*0.2)*K[i]*focus, with K = [1.3 red, 1.0 orange, 0.65 yellow, 1.1 pink] to even out their luminance; neon blink 2.2/0.3. Add a third parameter focus: in TownScene SunAndSky (line 162), glowFocus += ((close||two ? 0.6 : 1) - glowFocus)*min(1,dt*2), then updateGlow(s.lightsOn, t, glowFocus). FIX 4, post (TownScene.tsx:322-325): <N8AO aoRadius={1.6} intensity={1.6} .../>, <Bloom mipmapBlur luminanceThreshold={1.1} luminanceSmoothing={0.3} intensity={0.5} radius={0.55} />, Vignette darkness 0.32. Keep ACES (don't change the daytime style); try AgX or NEUTRAL only as an A/B. FIX 5, light placement (Props.tsx:116,123): lamp intensity on*14 → on*18. Replace i%3===0 with LIT = new Set([0,3,7,8,9]): bakery road, café terrace, and the two plaza/town-hall lamps at (±11.2,-24.8) plus the shopping street, instead of the far sidewalk and harbour. Add one festival point light at (0,5.2,-13.4), colour #ffb36b, intensity on*26, distance 20, decay 1.3. That covers the stage (7 m), vendor (10 m), police and town-hall steps (13 m) with a net +1 light. Mount every light at load with intensity 0 to avoid shader recompiles. FIX 6: remove castShadow from the instanced lanterns at Props.tsx:235 (dotted shadows on faces). VERIFY: screenshots at 18:30, 19:30 and 20:00 on the plaza preset and in a close shot of the stage, before and after.
proposals.risk: Low (parameters only). The mood shifts from black night toward 'blue hour', so tune 20.5 sunI between 0.8 and 1.0 by screenshot. The sun-to-moon lerp swings shadows during the last ~20% of the story, which reads as moonrise. LITE (no composer) is unaffected except for the lights.

proposals.title: World-state lighting: validated consequences become visible beats
proposals.player_experience: When the mayor really cancels the festival, the plaza lanterns go out one string at a time. When a shop closes, its warm window goes dark. If the festival survives to 20:00, every lantern flares and the big fountain lantern pulses: a tiny, earned climax. You can see what your sentence did to the town at a glance.
proposals.inspired_by: Plague Inc. (the world map visibly changes as the consequence lands), Two Point (rooms visibly change state), Hitman (systemic reactions are readable)
proposals.implementation: Honest by construction: it reads only show.world, which is built from validated events (the same source as PlaybackLayer.tsx WorldChanges, lines 155-240). (a) clock.ts: add glow.festival (0..1, smoothed). In TownScene SunAndSky (line 162): target = show.world?.festival === 'cancelled' ? 0.1 : 1, approached at 1.5/s. Stagger the 4 lantern materials by 0.4 s so the strings go out in sequence. Multiply the lantern term in updateGlow and the fountain lantern by it. (b) Closed shops: in Buildings.tsx useShopMats (line 713), register interiorMaterial per building id (glow.shopInterior[b.id] = m). In updateGlow, if show.world.shops[id] === 'closed', ease emissiveIntensity to 0.05. Shop door lamps (Buildings.tsx:359) can switch to a per-shop clone in the same way. (c) Stage closed: the stage bulbs (P8 proscenium) switch off, alongside the existing tape and cones. (d) Festival start: when show.gameT crosses 20:00 (clock.hour ≥ 20) and festival !== 'cancelled', run a lantern flare K*2.6 for 1.5 s and a fountain lantern scale pulse 1→1.25→1, with an sfx sting if one exists. Reset everything on show.loads changes (replay/What If).
proposals.risk: Low. Make sure the What If/replay reset re-reads world state from the start of the log. The flare must stay below about 1.5x the new threshold to avoid a bloom whiteout.

proposals.title: Character pop: rim light, night self-lift, eye sparkle and blob shadows (characters only)
proposals.player_experience: At night every resident has a soft warm outline against the dark ground, faces keep their skin tone instead of going purple-grey, and the eyes keep a sparkle. Each person also stands on a soft contact shadow, so a crowd scene reads as individuals rather than a blob.
proposals.inspired_by: Stylised character rim (Zelda: BotW, Hades readability), Two Point (characters always pop from the set)
proposals.implementation:
Crowd.tsx: the Person materials at line 229 currently use mat(), which is shared with buildings and props, so they must not be modified. Add a separate cache: const charU = {uRim:{value:0}, uRimColor:{value:new THREE.Color('#ffd9a8')}}; function cmat(color, rough=0.75){ ... new MeshStandardMaterial({color, roughness:rough, emissive:color, emissiveIntensity:0}); m.onBeforeCompile = sh => { Object.assign(sh.uniforms, charU); sh.fragmentShader = sh.fragmentShader.replace('#include <common>', '#include <common>
uniform float uRim; uniform vec3 uRimColor;').replace('#include <emissivemap_fragment>', '#include <emissivemap_fragment>
float rimF = pow(1.0 - clamp(dot(normal, normalize(vViewPosition)), 0.0, 1.0), 2.5);
totalEmissiveRadiance += uRimColor * rimF * uRim;'); }; m.customProgramCacheKey = () => 'viral-char-rim'; }. The chunk order was verified in node_modules/three meshphysical.glsl.js: normal_fragment_begin at line 182 comes before emissivemap_fragment at line 186, and vViewPosition = -mvPosition. Use cmat for skin, shirt, pants, hair, hat, apron, scarf and the kit gear. In the Crowd root useFrame (line 392): const n = skyAt(clock.hour).lightsOn; charU.uRim.value = 0.06 + n*0.34; every char material gets emissiveIntensity = n*0.14 (skin n*0.2). Peak rim luminance is about 0.35, under the new bloom threshold of 1.1. Eye sparkle: G.shine material (line 333) becomes MeshBasicMaterial #ffffff (no lighting). Blob shadows: one InstancedMesh with PlaneGeometry(1,1).rotateX(-pi/2) and a MeshBasicMaterial (radial dark gradient from a new textures.ts blobTexture(), transparent, depthWrite false), count = agents.length. Each frame set the matrix to (a.x, 0.03, a.z) with scale 0.9*1.3*look.scale*visible, and opacity 0.18+n*0.22. That is 1 draw call. Optional warm ground light pools: one additive InstancedMesh of radial planes at LAMPS (scale 6), the plaza centre (16), stalls (4) and shop doors (3.5), opacity n*0.32. Characters then silhouette against lit ground.
proposals.risk: Medium. The onBeforeCompile injection must be retested on a three upgrade. The program cache key gives one compile, but the first frame compiles about 40 variants anyway. The rim also lights hats and gear, which is intended. Disable the blob plane in LITE if e2e screenshots compare pixels.

proposals.title: Plaza as the festival stage: big fountain lantern, festival arch, real stage proscenium, prep tables
proposals.player_experience: From any zoom the plaza reads as the place where tonight happens. A giant tiered lantern crowns the fountain. A red festival arch frames the shopping street entrance. The stage has a truss with bulbs, speakers and a deep-red backdrop that makes whoever stands on it pop. Volunteers' prep tables are stacked with unlit lanterns.
proposals.inspired_by: Theatre staging and focal objects (The Sims and Two Point room centrepieces), Hitman landmark points of interest
proposals.implementation: (a) Centrepiece, Props.tsx Fountain lines 265-267: replace the 0.35 sphere with a tiered lantern at y POLE_TOP+0.45: body Cyl(0.5,0.5,0.8,16) using glow.lanterns[0], gold caps Cyl(0.55,0.55,0.08) #d4af37 top and bottom, a top knob, and a tassel Cone(0.08,0.4) #d4af37 below. Shadow off. This is also the P5 flare target. (b) Festival arch at the shopping-street gateway: group at (-10.5,-5.0), rotY -0.552. Its local x runs across the street; the street centre was checked at (-10.41,-4.95). Posts Cyl(0.16,0.18,5.0,12) #c2332f at local x ±3.3, i.e. world (-7.69,-3.27) and (-13.31,-6.73), 0.8 m beyond the cobble edge. Beam Box(7.6,0.32,0.32) at y5.0. Lintel Box(8.2,0.18,0.42) at y5.45 with upturned end blocks rotZ ±0.15. Gold base rings. Sign plane 2.6x0.75 at y4.45 using signTexture('燈籠節','LANTERN FESTIVAL','#c2332f','#ffe08a'). 3 lanterns (glow.lanterns) hang at x -2, 0, 2, y 4.3. Add both posts to OBSTACLE_CIRCLES (layout.ts:381) at r 0.25, then run node scripts/check-layout.ts. Planter (-11,-6.2) is 2.4 m away; ramen OBB is 0.8 m away. Placed here it does not occlude the plaza centre in the default view (the camera looks from the SE). (c) Stage (Props.tsx:272-300, STAGE OBB unchanged): top truss Box(w-0.4,0.18,0.18) at local y3.95 on the existing back posts (lines 287-290, raised from 3.2 to 4.0 tall). 7 bulbs Sphere(0.07) along it using a new glow.bulb (emissive 0.15+n*1.2, below bloom). Backdrop plane (w-0.6)x2.4 #8e1f2a at z -d/2+0.1, y 0.7-3.1 (a solid figure-ground for performers). Speaker stacks RoundedBox(0.6,0.9,0.5) #2b2b2b with grey cone discs on the deck corners at local (±(w/2-0.45), 1.15, 0.6). (d) Temporary prep tables: T1 (-5.4,-23.4) and T2 (5.2,-23.6), rot 0. Each has a top Box(1.6,0.06,0.8) at y0.75, a red cloth Box(1.62,0.4,0.82) #c2332f, 3 unlit paper lanterns Sphere(0.18).scale(1,1.25,1) #fff4e3, a cash box Box(0.25,0.12,0.18) #3d405b, and 2 stools. Add OBBs {w:1.8, d:1.0} to OBSTACLE_OBBS. Clearances: planters at (±8.2,-23.6) are 1.2 m away, the steps OBB ends at x ±2.7. Add a 'linger' POI in front of each, so townsfolk cluster and chat there.
proposals.risk: Medium. The arch and stage truss may occlude some director close shots (check the stage close-up and the vendor two-shot). New obstacles change crowd paths (deterministic, but lab metrics may shift). Keep shadows only on the arch and tables.

proposals.title: Town hall as the power centre: tall flags, festival banners, red carpet, press podium
proposals.player_experience: The town hall stops being a pretty green box. Two tall waving flags rise above the roofline, red festival banners hang between the columns, a red carpet runs down the steps, and a press podium stands under the portico. You instantly know where official statements and power live, and where the mayor will defend himself.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman (each area has a readable authority landmark), Two Point (room identity through signature props)
proposals.implementation: Buildings.tsx TownHall, lines 780-855 (H = 7.4, front = 4.5 local, so world z ≈ -26.1). (a) Flagpoles, lines 843-852: pole Cyl(0.04,0.06,7.6) at y3.8 (was 4.4), gold finial Sphere(0.08) at y7.65, flag Box(1.5,0.95,0.03) at [0.78,7.0,0] (was 0.8x0.5 at y3.9). Colours: town green #2f5a37 with a gold border strip, and festival red #c2332f. Wrap in a <Flag> with useFrame: rotY sin(t*1.6+i)*0.22, scale.x 1+sin(t*2.3+i)*0.05. (b) Vertical banners between the outer columns: planes 0.95x2.8 at local [±2.6, 5.0, front-0.42]. The texture is a new textures.ts vbannerTexture() with 燈/籠/節 stacked in #ffe08a on #b5262b, gold edge, emissiveIntensity 0.1. (c) Red carpet #b5262b: slope Box(1.5,0.02,1.6) at [0,0.24,front+0.6] rotX 0.28, plus a flat Box(1.5,0.02,2.0) at [0,0.42,front-1.1] on the portico. (d) Podium on the portico between the centre columns (x ±1.3), at local [0,0.4,front-0.45]. This is inside the building OBB, so nav is unchanged. Body Box(0.7,1.1,0.5) #6b4f3a, slanted top plate, gold emblem disc Cyl(0.16,0.16,0.02) rotX pi/2 #d4af37 at the front, mic stand Cyl(0.012,..,0.4) with a Sphere(0.03) head. (e) Two small uplights on the step sides (Box 0.2x0.12x0.2 using glow.bulb) plus the relocated plaza point lights (P4 LIT indices 7 and 8) wash the facade at night. Optional later: if the director moves the mayor to the podium for public_statement, it becomes his stage. Treat that as a director change for the lead.
proposals.risk: Low. Flags above 7 m may overlap the clock tower from some angles (tower at z -2.6 local, y H+0.3..). Keep flags at x ±5.9 (current). No nav change.

proposals.title: Quiet the generic crowd so core residents pop (palette and hat hygiene)
proposals.player_experience: The background townsfolk still look varied and cheerful, but slightly softer. The eight people who matter, in their saturated signature colours and unique hats, are the first thing your eye lands on.
proposals.inspired_by: Figure-ground principle; Hitman (targets and VIPs readable within crowds); Two Point (patients vs staff colour language)
proposals.implementation: Visual-only, inside Crowd.tsx Person, line 229: for agents with no kit, run shirt, pants, hatColor and backpack through muted(c) = lerp toward warm grey #bfb6a8 by 0.2 (kids 0.1), using cached THREE.Color math. Skin and hair stay untouched. Core kits use raw colours. Hat hygiene, so only core residents own the iconic hats: (1) in Crowd.tsx, render a generic 'sunhat' as 'cap' unless kit === florist, and the balloon seller's sunhat (crowdSim.ts:211) as cap. (2) The ramen cook keeps the short G.chef hat; nobody else wears the tall toque. (3) Optionally drop the neon hair colours #6bcb77 #ff8fab #4d96ff #b983ff from HAIR (crowdSim.ts:76). Replacing entries keeps the pick() call count and therefore the RNG stream, but do it in Crowd.tsx as a display remap to avoid touching crowdSim while the lead works there.
proposals.risk: Low. The town may read slightly less candy-coloured. A/B with lerp 0.15-0.25.

proposals.title: Shopping street as the social street: bunting canopy, café string lights, working-shop states
proposals.player_experience: The diagonal shopping street gets a zig-zag of colourful bunting overhead. The café terrace twinkles with string lights at dusk. The bakery chimney puffs, the takoyaki griddle steams, and flower buckets and a newspaper bundle sit outside their doors. It looks like a street people actually linger in.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point and Animal Crossing set dressing, Untitled Goose Game (lived-in village)
proposals.implementation: New components in StreetProps.tsx. (a) Bunting, replacing Pennants (StreetProps.tsx:262-272): catenary strings with sag 0.6 m, drawn as drei Line plus instanced triangle flags (BufferGeometry triangle 0.28 wide x 0.36 tall, DoubleSide) every 0.55 m, oriented along the string, in 4 colour InstancedMeshes (#e2574c #ffd23f #3a86ff #6bcb77). Spans (y 3.4-3.6): bakery facade fromLocal(bakery,2.6,3.05) ≈ (-20.27,4.71) → pole P1 (-13.4,7.6); P1 → flower fromLocal(flower,-2.4,2.55) ≈ (-17.45,2.23); flower fromLocal(flower,2.4,2.55) ≈ (-15.49,-2.15) → pole P2 (-10.4,0.6); P2 → ramen fromLocal(ramen,-2.4,2.75) ≈ (-14.05,-5.6). Poles: Cyl(0.05,0.06,3.8) #7a5a3a, both on the green just east of the cobble. Add them to OBSTACLE_CIRCLES at r 0.2 and confirm with scripts/check-layout.ts. (b) Café terrace lights: 2 catenaries from fromLocal(cafe,±2.6,3.3) at y3.0 to new posts at (14.2,10.8) and (20.8,10.6) (both at the patch edge; add to obstacles). Bulbs Sphere(0.06) every 0.45 m, instanced, using glow.bulb (emissive 0.15+n*1.2, so no bloom). (c) Smoke/steam: a <Puffs at=[x,y,z]> component with 5 spheres cycling y 0→2.4, scale 0.25→0.9, opacity 0.55→0 (shared transparent white MeshStandard, depthWrite false), period 4 s. Use it at the bakery chimney (pitched roof Chimney at local [w*0.28, H+0.6+1.6, -d*0.2]), over the takoyaki griddle (STALLS[2] local [0,1.3,0.2], faster and smaller) and over the seafood grill. Skip in LITE. (d) Working props at doors, placed with fromLocal(b, doorX(b) ± 1.0, b.d/2 + 0.5): flower shop 3 metal buckets Cyl(0.16,0.13,0.3) #9aa1a9 with flower clusters; news 3 tied bundles Box(0.4,0.2,0.3) #f5f2e8 and a '號外' sandwich board; mart 2 stacks of blue drink crates Box(0.5,0.3,0.35) #3a86ff; bakery 3 flour sacks Sphere(0.25).scale(1,0.7,0.8) #efe6d2 against the side wall.
proposals.risk: Low to medium. More meshes in the busiest view (about 20 draw calls if instanced). Bunting poles and terrace posts change nav slightly. Puffs are transparent sorting objects, so keep them few.

proposals.title: Harbour as the work node: jib crane, gulls, buoys and nets, fish crates
proposals.player_experience: The harbour reads as a working port from the overview: a yellow crane slowly swings a crate between quay and boats, gulls wheel overhead, and buoys and drying nets line the rail. The journalist's harbour-side office and the dockworkers sit in a place with its own rhythm.
proposals.inspired_by: RimWorld and Dwarf Fortress (work sites with ongoing labour), Untitled Goose Game (ambient activity), Two Point (moving machines signal function)
proposals.implementation: New Harbour component (StreetProps.tsx or Terrain.tsx). (a) Jib crane at the quay (45.2,-11.4); add it to OBSTACLE_CIRCLES at r 0.7. Clearances: crates (44.6,-13.2) 1.9 m, linger POI z -10 at 1.4 m; it stays off the DOCK_ROUTE pier at z -17..-14.6. Base RoundedBox(1.4,0.5,1.4) #3d405b. Mast Cyl(0.16,0.18,5.6) #f4c542 at y3.05. Cab Box(0.9,0.8,0.9) at y5.6. Jib Box(6.0,0.22,0.22) at y6.0 offset +2.6 in local x. Counterweight Box(0.8,0.6,0.6) #e2574c at local x -1.0. Cable Cyl(0.012,0.012,3.2) from the jib tip with a hanging RoundedBox(0.8) crate at y2.6. Animate the slewing group at rotY 0.6+sin(t*0.12)*0.7 so the crate travels from the quay out over the water toward the boat at (56,-9); the cable sways at rotZ sin(t*0.9)*0.05. Cast shadows only on the mast and jib. (b) Gulls: 4 groups orbiting (48,-12) at radius 6-10 and y 7-9, speed 0.25-0.4 rad/s, each a Sphere(0.12).scale(1,0.8,1.6) body plus 2 Box(0.5,0.02,0.16) wings flapping at rotZ sin(t*8)*0.5. That is 12 meshes. Skip in LITE. (c) Buoys Sphere(0.18) with stripeTexture('#e2574c','#ffffff',4), instanced, hanging on the rail at x COAST_X-0.25, y 0.75, z [-36,-33,-6.6,-4,8]. Net piles: Icosahedron(1,1).scale(1.2,0.3,0.9) #4a6b5a at (42.8,-35.2) and (42.6,-8.6). (d) Fish crates by the FRESH FISH stall at (42.6,-19.4): 2 stacked Box(0.6,0.25,0.4) #f4f4f4 with 3 blue Capsule(0.05,0.2) fish on ice. Add to obstacles at r 0.6. (e) Optional, effort M: the far boat (Terrain.tsx:300, x 66) sails a slow ellipse centred (70,-10) with radii (8,22) over a 180 s period, with a white flattened wake plane.
proposals.risk: Low to medium. The crane must not block dockworkers (verify the path with check-layout and by watching 2 minutes). Gulls are cheap but disable them in LITE and recordings if frame time is tight.

proposals.title: Instanced life-prop scatter plus new gathering spots (pots, crates, chalk stands, benches by props)
proposals.player_experience: Every shop door has potted plants, stalls have stock stacked behind them, and corners hold small clutter. New props become places where townsfolk naturally stop and chat (the dove cages, the prep tables, the notice board), so small knots of people form where the story will happen.
proposals.inspired_by: The Sims (objects create social affordances), RimWorld (gathering spots), Two Point (decoration density)
proposals.implementation: (a) Generic <Scatter geo material items/> in StreetProps.tsx, following the instanced pattern already used in Fences (lines 132-168): items {x,z,y?,rot?,s?} → setMatrixAt in useLayoutEffect. One draw call per geometry and material. (b) Data in layout.ts as a new export LIFE, so scripts/check-layout.ts can lint it. POTS: for every shop except the town hall, fromLocal(b, doorX(b)-0.85, b.d/2+0.35) and fromLocal(b, -b.w/2+0.45, b.d/2+0.35), about 18 pots. Pot Cyl(0.22,0.17,0.42,10) #c4643e. Foliage Icosahedron(0.3,1) in 3 colour instances (#5fb256 #ff6fa0 #ffd23f). They sit 0.35 m off the wall, clear of the worker posts at doorX±1.1/d/2+0.7. STOCK behind the plaza stalls at local (±0.9,0.2,-0.95): RoundedBox crates #c49a6c and #a87f55, 2 per stall, inside the stall OBB (layout.ts:396), so nav is unchanged. (c) Gathering POIs (layout.ts POIS, lines 417-463). Add 'browse' at the notice board: SPOTS.plaza minus (1.2,0.6), facing it. That board (PlaybackLayer.tsx:172) is also missing from OBSTACLE_OBBS today, so people walk through it; add {x:board.x-1.2, z:board.z-0.6, w:1.8, d:0.4, rot:0.4}. Add 'linger' at the dove cages (kids 4), at each prep table, and at the crane (elders 2, at the quay rail facing it). (d) Audit fix while here: the stall OBB at layout.ts:396 subtracts 0.3 in world z regardless of rotation, so the takoyaki stall (rot -0.5) and the harbour stalls (rot W) are offset. Use fromLocal(s,0,-0.3) instead.
proposals.risk: Medium. POI and obstacle changes alter deterministic crowd behaviour and could shift lab fun-metrics or e2e baselines. Run check-layout plus one e2e afterwards, not while the owner playtests.

cut: The HUD's town-statistics lines in TownScene.tsx Hud, lines 225-230 ('70 位鎮民：x 人在走動…' and the cat/dog count). They are simulator telemetry, not 'what is happening now'.
The always-open time slider and the 暫停/1×/4×/12× speed buttons in the explore HUD (TownScene.tsx:235-274). Collapse them into a small clock chip that expands on click.
The single 0.55×0.85 flags bolted onto 7 lamp posts (StreetProps.tsx Pennants, lines 262-272). They look accidental; replace them with the bunting strings.

Wrong clothing language on core residents: the news-shop apron on 小雯 (inherited via crowdSim.ts:223), the chef hat on 阿珠 (crowdSim.ts:209 i===2), the chief's look identical to his officers (lines 222 vs 237), and random glasses/scarf/blush rolls on core residents.

Generic townsfolk wearing iconic hats: the random 'sunhat' in HATS (crowdSim.ts:77) and on the balloon seller (line 211), which should belong to the florist. Also the neon hair colours (#6bcb77 #ff8fab #4d96ff #b983ff), which compete with the signature colours.
castShadow on the ~60 instanced festival lanterns and the fountain lantern (Props.tsx:235). It adds dotted shadow noise on faces and the ground and costs shadow-pass draws.
Bloom on every window, interior and door lamp (windows 1.65, door/street lamps 6.2 emissive). Glow should be reserved for the festival lanterns.
The 4.0-intensity blinking red/blue neon on the police/mart mascots and the news antenna. Blinking halos at the frame edge steal attention from story beats; cap them at 2.2.
Vignette darkness 0.45 (TownScene.tsx:325). Combined with the night grade it crushes the frame edges where the director often places the second person of a two-shot.
